title: Bialetti: Pressure / Patience
challenge: Reposition an iconic 1933 stovetop espresso maker against single-serve pod convenience (Nespresso/Keurig) and intimidating third-wave coffee gear (Chemex) without competing on speed.
insight: Modern coffee culture automates mornings into a rushed, sterile routine; consumers fatigued by single-use plastic pods crave an intentional, sensory 4-minute ritual before the workday starts.
execution: Directed an integrated cross-channel campaign ("Good coffee takes fire, not plastic") spanning commuter OOH transit shelters, notification-contrast social carousels, and an interactive Figma 4-Minute Morning Reset microsite.
results: Delivered a cohesive brand platform and interactive digital prototype that turns Bialetti's 4-minute brew time from a functional barrier into its primary emotional differentiator.

title: Target: High Taste. Low Stakes.
challenge: Cut through cluttered retail value messaging to reach style-conscious older Gen Z and Millennials (ages 23–35) balancing entry-level salaries with aspirational aesthetic standards.
insight: Young professionals want the social currency of editorial, heirloom-grade taste without the financial anxiety or buyer's remorse of luxury debt.
execution: Developed a unified brand voice platform ("High Taste. Low Stakes.") juxtaposing high-fashion editorial silhouettes and sculptural home goods against everyday errand touchpoints across highway billboards, bus shelters, and subway placements.
results: Established a scalable, unmistakable campaign voice that elevates Target's everyday staples into accessible luxury without losing mass-market warmth.

title: Kin Euphorics: Enter Your Flow State
metric: Complete Brand Voice Architecture & OOH Launch
challenge: Differentiate functional adaptogenic beverages in a crowded non-alcoholic market where competitors either sound overly clinical or apologize for lacking alcohol.
insight: High-output professionals aged 21–45 don't want to give up evening socializing—they want an elevated, lucid ritual that protects tomorrow's mental clarity.
execution: Built a comprehensive brand governance guide ("Is / Is Not" voice boundaries, strategic shift matrix, and 20-line copy bank) and translated it into commuter OOH placements centered on entering a clear-headed "Flow State."
results: Created a disciplined brand positioning framework that commands premium lifestyle shelf appeal while keeping creative execution strictly aligned with consumer wellness habits.

title: NASCAR & Orvis: Dual-Brand Positioning Study
challenge: Solve two opposite brand growth challenges simultaneously: converting passive TV sports viewers into first-time live NASCAR attendees, and attracting screen-fatigued professionals to Orvis heritage fly-fishing.
insight: Both audiences suffer from screen inertia—NASCAR wins through visceral, high-decibel physical adrenaline ("Leave Your Couch in the Dust"), while Orvis wins through quiet, generational legacy ("Their First Cast, Your Best Memory").
execution: Managed end-to-end audience segmentation, emotional/functional needs mapping, hand-drawn concept ideation, and high-craft print/OOH visual executions tailored to each brand's distinct heritage.
results: Demonstrated versatile account stewardship by moving seamlessly between high-octane mass entertainment and quiet luxury heritage positioning.

title: Next-Gen AI Companion: Primary Research & Sensory Brand Architecture
challenge: Define how an AI robot companion should look, sound, and behave for Gen Z and Gen Alpha users without triggering the anxiety of intrusive "always-listening" smart speakers.
insight: Through in-depth qualitative interviews and Sensory-Functional-Emotional (SFE) mapping, we uncovered that young adults reject authoritative, bossy devices in favor of non-judgmental presence and ambient emotional safety.
execution: Co-led stakeholder mapping across 5 institutional/user tiers, moderated multi-stage participant interviews, and translated raw transcripts into three actionable sensory brand territories (The Grounded Confidant, The Spontaneous Instigator, and The Silent Observer).
results: Delivered a research-backed product and brand blueprint with concrete color, acoustic, and motion guidelines ready for industrial design and engineering handoff.

title: Asher + Rye: Omnichannel Retail & Cafe Digital Flagship
challenge: Unify a multi-concept Savannah lifestyle retailer—combining European home goods, custom interior design, and an artisan cafe—into a single intuitive digital experience.
insight: Local patrons and design clients visit Asher + Rye for its warm, tactile sense of community, yet fragmented digital menus and product browsing created friction between its retail and hospitality arms.
execution: Conducted competitive digital audits, mapped desktop and mobile wireframes, structured full-menu and catalog information architecture, and built an interactive Figma flagship prototype.
results: Streamlined customer navigation across three distinct business verticals while preserving the boutique's warm, neighborhood hospitality online.
